options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Victory Condition
options.doc:
Choose what the victory condition of your run is:
'Any%' - You must defeat the Queen of Karst Castle
'True Ending' - You must get game's True Ending
'100%' - You must colelct every single randomized location and then beat the final boss
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez la condition de victoire de votre course :
'Any%' - Vous devez vaincre la Reine du château de Karst
'True Ending' - Vous devez obtenir True Ending du jeu
'100%' - Vous devez coller chaque emplacement randomisé et ensuite battre le patron final

options.name: Fast Kill
options.doc:
If this is enabled, any damage taken will instantly kill you, regardless of hp.
Can be on/off all the time or else only enabled during boss fights.

options.name: Include Ivory Bugs
options.doc: If this is enabled, Ivory Bug locations will be included as checks.

options.name: Include Vitality Fragments
options.doc: If this is enabled, Vitality Fragment locations will be included as checks.

options.name: HARD MODE
options.doc:
Makes item logic less strict. You will have to do speedrun tech to progress.
Specifically, no-hit boss drops and garden key skip are in logic.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc:
If enabled, dying will kill all other deathlink players, and vice versa.
Can be on/off all the time or else only enabled during boss fights.
options.doc_fr:
Si elle est activée, mourir tuera tous les autres joueurs, et vice versa.
Peut être activé/arrêt tout le temps ou autrement seulement activé pendant les combats de patron.

options.name: Death Link Amount
options.doc: How many deaths will it take to trigger a deathlink. (Ignored if Deathlink=never)
options.doc_fr: Combien de morts il faudra pour déclencher un lien de mort. (Ignoré si Deathlink=jamais)
